The arms above sum to 0.38 s, and `./run.sh all` runs `docs` and `gnn`

`docs` arm never depends on it.

Recorded 2026-11-12 on darwin arm64, Python 3.12.16, warm pip cache; one run per arm per layout. The two-job layout no longer
exists, so these numbers cannot be re-measured; the receipt above is the
current record.

| Comparison | Before (two jobs) | After (one job) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `docs` — links and metadata (plus index coverage after) | 0.11 s | 0.12 s – 0.59 s |
| `gnn` — parse and type-check | 0.30 s | 0.28 s – 0.72 s |
| provisioning | 10.36 s (2.24 s + 8.12 s); repeats 9.33 s, 9.99 s, 10.93 s | 6.78 s – 7.71 s; one virtual environment and one install |

The two jobs each created their own virtual environment and installed their own dependencies: the documentation job 2.24 s (`uv venv --seed` 0.39 s, `pyyaml==6.0.2` 1.85 s) and the conformance job 8.12 s (`uv venv --seed` 0.03 s, `defusedxml psutil pyyaml` 2.50 s, pinned parser 5.59 s), across two checkouts and two interpreters.

They also disagreed about a version: the conformance job resolved PyYAML to a later patch release than the documentation job pinned.

Check time did not move: repeated runs vary by more than any difference, and the index check added after the change cost less than run-to-run noise.

See [`run-guide.md`](run-guide.md) for what each arm checks.
